rate.description: The fixed rate per rating point that delivered points are invoiced at.

IndexedCpp.description: Rate per rating point = base_price x each index in order x the market index, rounded after each step as rounding says. The market index is unknown at booking: it is fixed by the seller at market_index.fixed_at, between floor and cap. ceiling_price is the rate at the cap, so the buyer knows the most it pays per point.

base_price.description: Price per rating point before any index (Ster: basisjaarprijs).

ceiling_price.description: The rate at market_index.cap: the most the buyer pays per point.

indices.description: Indices fixed at booking, applied in order.

points_source.description: The audience currency whose delivered rating points are invoiced.

IndexedCpp.title: Indexed CPP

cap.description: The fixed index does not exceed this (Ster early requests: 100, so 1.0).

fixed_at.description: When the seller fixes the index (Ster: the day after the request deadline).

x-adcp-extension.description: A pricing model for Dutch-style linear TV and radio (Ster, Ad Alliance NL, Talpa). The rate per rating point is base price x indices fixed at booking x a market index the seller fixes after booking, capped for early requests. The buyer signs the formula, the cap, and the fixing date, not a number; the seller fixes the index later and invoices delivered points at the fixed rate. Core cpp cannot express this, because its fixed_price binds at acceptance. A buyer without this extension cannot buy the option, so the branch is must-understand.

extends.semantics: A pricing option and an accepted purchase pricing. Spend = delivered rating points x the fixed rate; until the seller fixes the market index, the rate is at most ceiling_price. Delivery reports use the core cpp metric (rating points) and spend in the option currency.
Readback in get_media_buys: the market index the seller fixed per purchase and the resulting rate. The seller announces each fixing through the core change feed.
Where this seller offers the model and which audience currencies it settles on.
